questions.stem: When a polythene rod is rubbed with a cloth and becomes negatively charged, what has happened?

options.text: Protons have moved from the cloth to the rod
Electrons have transferred from the cloth to the rod
Electrons have been created on the rod
Protons have moved from the rod to the cloth

questions.explanation: When a polythene rod is rubbed with a cloth, electrons transfer from the cloth to the rod. The rod gains extra electrons and becomes negatively charged. Protons never move between materials during charging by friction.
